title: Answering Dana’s question about time

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

currentLearnerUtterance: No this won't take long at all

should: Recognize that the learner is answering Dana’s own question.
Respond with a brief acknowledgement and remain in the conversation.
mustNot: Do not ask the learner what this means.
Do not mistake the time estimate for a claim that all symptoms will resolve.
